description: Where a finished build of a builder MOBILE app can go: targets afs = the AppForShare Android store (it lists only apps it builds itself from reviewed source, so the app's GitHub repository becomes the store source), play = Google Play (the kept .aab through Send to Google Play: testing tracks on Pro, production as a draft on Team, the workspace's own Play connection), appstore = TestFlight and App Store review (the App Store signed .ipa, the workspace's own App Store Connect key, the customer's own Apple signing). Each target: ready, todo = everything still needed in plain words in order, checklist = the store readiness items (privacy policy address, Delete account, Data safety or App Privacy answers, content rating hints, permissions and store rules from the build; ok true = done, false = to do, null = answer it in the store), steps for the first time (Play: create the app in Play Console, the first .aab by hand, the upload key fingerprint), and sends = every send so far (where, status QUEUED, SENDING, PROCESSING, SENT, DRAFT, SUBMITTED = waiting for App Store review, SET = store source set, FAILED; the store answer, who and when). Without build: the newest finished build of platform (or of either platform). Sending is done by an Admin with an explicit confirm in the dashboard (App builder, the app, Release) or with the CLI (appforshare builder release), never from here. Read only. Every plan with an account; Google Play and TestFlight sends are Pro and Team.
